_comment: Ready-made Meeting Cards. Each card is a short message the user can send to the meeting chat (or copy). 'signs' is optional: sign IDs used for the on-panel avatar preview. A sign without a clip in avatar-signs.json is previewed as a text card. Cards without 'signs' fall back to the Speech -> Sign phrase table.

cards.text: Could you explain that again, please?
Could you please type that in the chat?
I would like to add something.
Please wait, I am typing my reply.
I communicate by text. I will reply in the chat.
